interface.signature: routes: List[List[int]], S: int, T: int -> int

preconditions.description: The number of bus routes must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(route) <= 10**5 for route in routes)
preconditions.description: Each bus route must contain between 1 and 100,000 stops.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= stop < 10**6 for route in routes for stop in route)
preconditions.description: All bus stops must be non-negative integers less than 1,000,000.
The starting stop S and destination stop T must be valid bus stops.

postconditions.expression: stdout == -1 if S not in any(route for route in routes) or T not in any(route for route in routes) else True
postconditions.description: If either S or T is not reachable by any bus route, the output must be -1.
The output must be a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of buses taken.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 1 if S == T else True
postconditions.description: If the starting stop S is the same as the destination stop T, the output must be 1.
